intro-kinematic.label: Carry and place a chair
intro-kinematic.caption: Fig. 1. Human demonstration and HOI-Retarget reference for carrying and placing a wooden chair. Kinematic replay without physics simulation.

intro-smallbox.label: Push and pull a box
intro-smallbox.caption: Fig. 2. Human demonstration and HOI-Retarget reference for pushing and pulling a box. Kinematic replay without physics simulation.

intro-dynamics.label: Clothes-stand dynamic execution
intro-dynamics.caption: Fig. 3b. Human demonstration and simulated clothes-stand manipulation. HOI-Retarget + SPIDER loses balance and tips the stand. HuMoTAR lifts, carries and places it on the floor.

discussion-plate.label: Swirl a plate
discussion-plate.caption: Fig. 11. Human demonstration and HuMoTAR execution of the plate-swirling task. The robot partially lifts the plate but does not complete the demonstrated swirling motion.

intro-chair-physics.label: Carry and place a chair
intro-chair-physics.caption: Fig. 3a. Carrying and placing a wooden chair. The unrefined HOI-Retarget reference is executed with SONIC and the supplied finger targets; it fails to lift the chair. HuMoTAR refines the motion and manipulation controller to carry and place it.
